name: Davis Winter Weeknight 2026
information: ## This competition is on a weekday! (Thursday) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
